description: UX Improvements - Header, Bet History & Bet Slip. Streamlined navigation with persistent header showing user info and balance, improved bet history grouped by ticket, enhanced game card odds grid with totals, and better bet slip UX.

userStories.title: Reorder tabs to Games, Track, Settings
userStories.description: As a user, I want the tab bar ordered logically so Games is my home screen and settings are secondary.
acceptanceCriteria: Tab order is: Games (1st), Track (2nd), Settings (3rd)
Games tab is selected by default on app launch
Tab icons and labels remain unchanged
Project builds successfully

userStories.title: Fix player balance color logic
userStories.description: As a user, I want balance colors to make sense: positive = good (I have credit), negative = I owe money.
acceptanceCriteria: Positive balance displayed in accent/green (player has credit)
Negative balance displayed in danger/red (player owes bookie)
Zero balance displayed in neutral/secondary color
Update any existing balance displays to follow this logic
Project builds successfully

userStories.title: Standardize card background color across app

acceptanceCriteria: Identify Account page card background color as the standard

All cards consistently use Theme.cardStyle() or Theme.cardBackground
